title: Limit unavailable companion-claim warnings to relevant received candidates
outcome: An optional held-claim read failure stays silent when the only retained receipt candidates belong to the root side the current placement mode does not consult.
acceptance: Shared and separate-root placement select receipt candidates only for the roots relevant to that mode.
A failed-read test with only an irrelevant-side candidate preserves BASE silence; relevant-candidate unavailable diagnostics and no-credit fences remain covered.
